metadata.description: Skills for integrating Authkestra, the framework-agnostic authentication orchestrator for Rust.

plugins.name: authkestra
plugins.description: Task-shaped skills for adding Authkestra to a Rust app: feature selection, the typestate builder, storage traits, OAuth/OIDC providers, MCP agent tool security, running your own OP, resource-server validation, passwordless/MFA/devsig, and upgrades.
